verdict.rationale: AgentMail is a service/API product (not itself an agent), so the MCP-server axis applies, and docs confirm a hosted official MCP server at https://mcp.agentmail.to/mcp exposing inbox, message, thread, draft, and attachment tools to any compatible client, corroborated by a probe hit. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that the MCP server works reliably in practice beyond first-party docs.
